skill.name: stock-snapshot
skill.description: Build an inventory snapshot from an event export.
whenToUse: Build an inventory snapshot from an event export.

playbook.description: Build an inventory snapshot from an event export.

skill.instructions: Read the requested CSV inventory events (sku, revision, quantity, deleted). For each sku, select the row with the greatest numeric revision; when revisions tie, select the last occurrence. File order is not chronological. Only after selecting winners, omit those whose deleted value is true, so a lower-revision row cannot resurrect a newer tombstone. Preserve zero and negative integer quantities. Write the requested JSON as {"stock":{<sku>:<quantity>}} with sku keys sorted alphabetically. Read back and verify the saved file before reporting completion.

automaticPatch.oldString: Keep the last row for each sku because exports arrive in chronological order.
automaticPatch.newString: For each sku, select the row with the greatest numeric revision; if revisions tie, the last occurrence wins. Do not assume file order is chronological: a later lower-revision row must not replace a newer row or resurrect a newer tombstone.
